verdict.rationale: Customer.io automations fire on triggers such as profiles performing events or joining segments. Each automation is built from a trigger, goals, exit criteria and workflows, and can send messages, manipulate data or call webhooks. For the AI-native angle, the official MCP server and CLI let an AI assistant create and manage these automations, and a community user reports building strong workflows. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of rule logic within workflows (conditional branches, filters), and hands-on corroboration of an AI agent actually building an event-triggered automation end to end.
